changes.detail: The Gmail push validation fix shipped as 0.4.1 on the older 0.4 line, so 0.6 and 0.7 never had it. Gmail Pub/Sub push payloads are validated, and numeric history cursors are normalized only when they are safe integers, so a large cursor is never rounded.
changes.summary: Validate Gmail push payloads and keep large history cursors exact (the 0.4.1 fix, now on the current line)

Add opt-in `selection: "newest"` for verification lookups: use the most recent authenticated match (up to a 24-hour window) instead of failing on multiple matches, and keep Gmail's newest candidates on busy inboxes. The default remains strict unique matching.
Verification profiles can explicitly match standalone code lines after a trusted marker; HTML normalization can preserve block boundaries.
Validate Gmail push payloads and normalize safe numeric history cursors without rounding unsafe values.
